question.problem: What is the sum of the first $N$ terms of a geometric series $2+18+162+⋯?$
question.worked_solution:
First, we determine the common ratio $r$ for this geometric series:

$$
\begin{aligned}r & =\frac{{a}_{2}}{{a}_{1}} \\  & =\frac{18}{2} \\  & =9\end{aligned}
$$

The sum of the first $N$ terms of a geometric series can be determined by the formula

$$
{S}_{N}=\frac{{a}_{1}(1-{r}^{N})}{1-r}.
$$

In this case ${a}_{1}=2$ and $r=9.$ Substituting these values into the formula for ${S}_{N}$ gives the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}{S}_{N} & =\frac{{a}_{1}(1-{r}^{N})}{1-r} \\  & =\frac{2(1-{9}^{N})}{1-9} \\  & =\frac{2(1-{9}^{N})}{(-8)} \\  & =-\frac{1}{4}(1-{9}^{N}) \\  & =\frac{1}{4}({9}^{N}-1)\end{aligned}
$$
